thesis.problem: Cat owners need a playful way to remember and record recurring grooming and hygiene care.
thesis.target_user: Chinese-speaking cat owners in the US (owner decision 2026-10-30); aspiring owners get a lightweight preset-cat path.
thesis.product_hypothesis: A companion-relationship app: gentle care check-ins and a home-screen widget cat that resembles the owner's real cat build a family-like bond across real and virtual life.
thesis.differentiation: Combines practical grooming tracking with playful virtual-pet progression instead of behaving like a conventional pet-health tracker.
thesis.product_direction: C: real-world grooming check-ins drive growth of a personalized digital cat
thesis.core_loop: Appropriate real care -> check-in -> gentle digital-cat progression -> care history/reminders
thesis.companion_direction: Pocket Kitty: ambient cute electronic cat with optional small home-screen widget, gentle affection and no streak pressure
thesis.onboarding_direction: Two paths: real cat with optional photo-derived digital likeness, or adopt a virtual kitty; photo upload skippable.
thesis.multi_cat: Separate profiles, avatars, grooming records and reminders for each real cat; add/switch cats.
thesis.personality_direction: Optional per-cat personality traits shape digital-cat behaviors and dialogue; user-editable.
thesis.relationship_direction: Owner-described real-cat relationships guide playful multi-cat digital interactions.
thesis.memories_direction: Private-by-default owner diary, milestones and optional AI fictional cat-perspective entries and group portraits, clearly labeled.
thesis.visual_direction: Semi-realistic soft digital cats; recognizable coat/eyes/face from user photo, natural behavior, preset options without photo.

evidence.finding: Hygiene care tracking and reminders already exist
Pet-care reminders and to-dos already exist
Do not incentivize unnecessary ear cleaning or stressful grooming

risks: Grooming tasks may be too infrequent to create a strong retention loop.
The playful digital-cat layer may delight users without improving recurring care behavior.
Widget and mascot delight may not translate into recurring grooming logging; test novelty versus durable value.
Photo avatar processing adds privacy, quality, cost and complexity risks; validate demand before committing to image-generation MVP.
Generative cat diaries and portraits must be labeled fictional; distinguish them from real care logs and protect uploaded photos.

validation.riskiest_assumption: Cat owners have enough recurring grooming pain or forgetfulness to return to a dedicated grooming app.
validation.cheapest_next_validation: Interview 5–8 cat owners about recent care tasks and missed care; compare simple tracker vs digital-cat progression prototype; invite to 2-week trial.
validation.positive_signal: Target users report recurring missed grooming or tracking friction and express intent to use the concept repeatedly.
validation.negative_signal: Most target users already manage grooming easily and see the experience as novelty-only.
validation.proposed_positive_threshold: At least 4/8 report concrete recent tracking friction and 4/8 opt into prototype trial (proposed)
validation.proposed_negative_threshold: Fewer than 2/8 report friction or fewer than 2/8 opt into trial (proposed)
recruitment_screener: Owns a cat for 2+ years (initial screening proxy)
Has a busy work or family schedule
Personally manages at least one recurring grooming/care task
interview_questions: What grooming tasks did you actually perform in the last 30 days?
What did you postpone or forget, if anything?
How do you remember or log care now?
What is frustrating about that approach?
Would a plain care log solve anything?
Would digital-cat progression tied to appropriate real care make you return?
Would you try a two-week prototype, and why?

decision.strongest_reason: Owner reframed the product as a companion-relationship app, chose a reachable first cohort, and can recruit testers directly.
decision.biggest_uncertainty: Whether testers keep checking in during week 2 without push notifications.
decision.next_action: Build a throwaway TestFlight prototype (preset cat, 3-5 check-ins, widget) and run a 2-week test with a survey and ~5 interviews.
